typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	AuditFolder as string (),
	Count as integer (),
	EmailRecipientFailure as string (),
	EmailRecipientSuccess as string (),
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	EndDate_Adhoc as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	FTPFolder as string (),
	OutputFolder as string (),
	ProcessRunDate as timestamp (),
	RowCount as integer (),
	StartDate as timestamp (),
	StartDate_Adhoc as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		Header as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @Count INT SET @Count = ?  SELECT CAST(REPLACE(STR(@Count,10),\' \',\'0\') AS CHAR(10)) + SPACE(158) +CHAR(13)+CHAR(10) AS Header',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> HeaderRow
HeaderRow sink(input(
		Header as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Header)) ~> WriteHeaderRow
